tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// snyan brgyud yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i bskyed pa'i rim pa rgyas pa 'dod pa'i re skong zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// bde ba'i mchog gcig sngon gyi smon lam gyis// sna tshogs mos ngor 'phangs pas rnam mang ba'i// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i nang nas gsang ba'i mtha'/ gang der btud nas de yi sgrub thabs bri// 'dir dpal 'khor lo sdom pa drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga jo bo nā ro ta ba'i rgya gzhung ji lta ba nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/ tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi dang*/ bla ma la gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ phung khams skye mched byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ srung ba'i 'khor lo dang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs dang*/ rten dkyil 'khor dang*/ rgyu dus kyi he ru ka dang*/ 'bras bu'i he ru kar bzhed pa dang*/ phra mo'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ go bgo ba dang*/ ye shes pa dgug bstim dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ bzlas pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa dang*/ phrin las bskul ba'i gtor ma dang bcu bdun la bslab par bya'o// dang po/ re zhig mal nas langs te gdong la sogs ba bkrus nas 'jig rten gsum nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa'i 'byung po'i tshogs 'dres pa dang*/ g.yo ba'i keng rus dang ldan pa'i phyir dur khrod du bltas te bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas kha lhor blta bas/ sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba bsgrub par 'dod pa rtse gcig pas/ skyabs sems/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang*// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' che// yi dam dpa' bo rnal 'byor tshogs// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// deng nas brtsams te mgon med bdag /byang chub snying po ma thob bar// 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa chen po las// bdag dang 'gro rnams bskyab pa'i phyir// rkang gnyis gtso bo sku gsum bdag /bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su mchi// 'dod chags bral zhing mya ngan 'das// zhi ba'i chos la skyabs su mchi// tshogs kyi mchog gyur sa la bzhugs// phyir mi ldog la skyabs su mchi/

sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ bla ma mchog la skyabs su mchi// dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha// dkyil 'khor lha la skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa// gnyug ma'i sems la skyabs su mchi// bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis// sngon chad sdig pa ci bgyis pa// mgon po khyed kyi spyan sngar bshags// slan chad sdig las ldog par bgyi// deng nas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi// khyed kyi bslab byar rjes su slob// khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' bas// kun nas yongs su bskyab tu gsol// zhes skyabs su song la/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad ltar// byang chub sems ni bla na med/ dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis sgrol// ma grol ba rnam bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs byung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// rdor sems bsgom bzlas/ rang gi spyi bor pam̐ las padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje snyem ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa// gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa// zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/

mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol lo/ oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ badzra satwa te no pa tiṣthadri ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ sarba siddhi mme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsittaṃ shre yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badzra mā me muñtsa/ badzrī bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ yig brgya ci nus bzla/ mthol bshags 'bul ba ni/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa che/ thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol lo/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang nyid la thim par gyur/ brgyud 'debs ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen rnal 'byor ma// de sras tilli nā ro dang*// lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan mar mi la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// ras chung zhabs dang khyung tshang pa/ ma gcig kong jo lo chen zhang*// dha ra shrī bsod nams mtshan// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// kun ldan ras ma bde legs dpal// kun dga'i dpal dang rgyal ba'i dbang*// ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po la// gsol ba= rdo rje sems dngos pad dkar zhabs// rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab lha rtse ba// rje btsun dpag bsam dbang po la// gsol ba= 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos buddha'i mtshan// ma lus 'gro ba'i yongs 'dzin rje// mchog gzigs yar 'phel dbang po la// gsol ba=

khyab bdag thugs kyi rdo rje dang*// he ru ka dpal bde chen sku// rdo rje nyi ma drin can rjer// gsol ba= kun mkhyen chos kyi snang ba che// snying po'i bstan 'dzin ye shes grub// nges don chos kyi rgya mtsho la// gsol ba= shes bya kun gzigs mkhyen pa'i gter// grub brnyes bstan pa'i nyi ma mchog /mthu chen chos kyi rgya mtsho la// gsol ba= 'dren mchog 'jam dpal nor bu'i zhabs// chos dbyings bde chen rdo rje rtsal// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong yang*// gang gi rol rtsed yin shes nas// rje btsun bla ma khyed min pa'i// skyabs gzhan bdag cag rnams mi tshol// de phyir nyam nga'i 'khor ba nas// 'gro ba 'dren pa'i thugs rje'i mthu// bskul ba'i gsol ba 'debs lags na// bsam pa lhun gyis grub par mdzod// smin byed dbang gi rgyud bsros nas// grol lam gser 'gyur rtsis bran pas// mi gtsang lus 'di rgyal ba'i sku// rin chen mchog tu gyur cig gu// shrī he ru ka zhes brjod cing*/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das yab yum du gyur pa'i zhal nas/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa hakṣaḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ yig 'bru'i tshogs dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas te lus kyi gnas thams cad gang bar gyur/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang phrad na ci ma rung snyam pa'i byams pa dang*/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral na ci ma rung snyam pa'i snying rje dang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba de yang rgyun brtan na ci ma rung snyam pa'i dga' ba dang*/ yang dag pa'i lam la gnas na ci ma rung snyam pa'i btang snyoms la gnas par bya'o/ /gnyis pa/ rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ ye shes lnga'i 'od zer 'phro bas bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor steng gi char bla ma bzhugs pa spyan drangs pa la/

na maḥte hūm̐/ na maḥmi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐ gis phyag byas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gi lus 'bul bar bgyi'o// zhes brjod de bdag gir 'dzin pa btang*/ snying ga nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis/ oṃ āḥbadzra bī ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā badzra waṃ she= mu rañdze= mṛ taṃ ge= hā sya= lā sye= gī tī= nri tye= puṣpe= dhū pe= ā lo ke= gandhe= rū pa= rā sya= sparshe= dharma dhā tu= oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ lha mo de dag dang gnyis su med pa snyoms par zhugs pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyis tshim par bsam/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*/ bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ bcom ldan mgon po dpa' bo'i dbang phyug ni/ bskal pa'i me chen ltar bur rab tu 'bar/ ral pa'i cod pan dbu yi rgyan du bcings/ mche ba rab gtsigs drag shul rngam pa'i zhal/ sku la phyag stong gzi brjid ldan pa po/ dgra st+wa zhags pa kha ṭwām̐ mdung bsnams shing*/ rab 'jigs stag gi pags pa gos su gyon/ sku chen duḥkha bgegs mthar mdzad la 'dud/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo 'phags ma ni/ 'jig rten gsum sogs phyogs gzhan rgol bas mi thub cing*/ 'byung po'i 'jig pa ma lus rdo rje chen mos 'joms/ rdo rje gdan bzhugs tshangs sogs dbang bsgyur las rgyal zhing*/ rdo rje phag mo khro mo'i gzugs can drag snyems ma/ rmug byed rengs byed myos byed las ni rnam rgyal zhing*/ bdud kyi 'jigs pa pham zhing skem par 'dzad pa mo/ rnal 'byor chen mo 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni/ mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo sgyur/ ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*/ 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma/

de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags/ slan chad gcod cing sdom pa'ang bgyid/ dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*// 'gro kun byang chub 'god bya'i phyir// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs par// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// bla ma sdom pa'i lha tshogs la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// 'gro ba'i don du sems bskyed cing*// lam chen dam pa brgyud la bsten// 'gro'i phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya shrī he ru ka twe no pa tiṣṭho dṛ me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ su poṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ sarba siddhi mme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsittaṃ shre yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badzra mā me muñtsa/ he ru ka bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ zhes yig brgya brjod/ pad kor gyi mthar 'khyud stangs byas/ tshogs zhing rang la bsdu'o/ gsum pa/ bdag nyid gtso bor bsgoms pa'i gzugs kyi phung po rnam par snang mdzad/ tshor ba rdo rje nyi ma/ 'du shes padma gar dbang*/ 'du byed rdo rje rgyal po/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po mi bskyod pa/ ye shes kyi phung po dpal he ru ka sa khams ltung byed ma/ chu gsod byed ma/ me 'gugs byed ma/ rlung gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ nam mkha' padma drwa ba can ma/ ye shes kyi khams chos kyi dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ mig gti mug rdo rje/ rna ba zhe sdang rdo rje/ sna ser sna rdo rje/ lce 'dod chags rdo rje/ lus phrag dog rdo rje/ yid dbang phyug rdo rje/ zhes las dang po pas mos pa brtag la goms nas rnam pa la sbyang ba'ang bshad do// bzhi pa/ g.yon pa'i lag pas se gol brdab cing*/ rtsa ba'i zhal nas/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ sngags kyi yig 'bru ri rab tsam pa kha dog dmar nag 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba ra ba lta bur bskor pa'i rtser/

khwa gdong ma shar du g.yon zhal nas/ oṃ gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ sngags kyi yig 'bru ri rab tsam pa kha dog dmar nag 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba ra ba lta bur bskor ba'i rtser/ 'ug gdong ma byang du// rgyab zhal nas oṃ gṛhṇā pa ya gṛ hṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ sngags kyi yig 'bru ri rab tsam kha dog dmar nag 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba ra ba lta bur bskor ba'i rtser/ khyi gdong ma nub tu/ g.yas zhal nas oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wan badzra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ sngags kyi yig 'bru ri rab tsam pa kha dog dmar nag 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba rwa ba lta bur bskor ba'i rtser phag gdong ma lhor/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ rtsa zhal nas mer sngags kyi yig 'bru ri rab tsam pa kha dog dmar nag 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba rwa ba lta bur bskor ba'i rtser/ gshin rje brtan ma/ oṃ gṛhna gṛhna huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ g.yas zhal nas srin por sngags kyi yig 'bru ri rab tsam pa kha dog dmar nag 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba rwa ba lta bur bskor ba'i rtser/ gshin rje pho nya mo/ oṃ gṛhna pa ya gṛhna pa ya hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ rgyab zhal nas rlung du sngags kyi yig 'bru ri rab tsam pa kha dog dmar nag 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba rwa ba lta bur bskor ba'i rtser/ gshin rje mche ba can ma/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥ bha ga wān badzra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ g.yon zhal nas dbang ldan du sngags kyi yig 'bru ri rab tsam pa kha dog dmar nag 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba rwa ba lta bur bskor ba'i rtser/ gshin rje 'joms ma/ lha mo rnams phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ 'og ma gnyis rdo rje'i tho ba dang phur bu/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du khyab pa'i khro mo'i sku dmar nag 'jigs pa'i me 'bar ba'i dbus na zhal phyir gzigs te gnas pa/ rwa ba chen po de yongs su gyur pa las/ oṃ me dī ni badzri bha wa badzra bandha hūm̐ bam̐ hūm̐/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi/

oṃ badzra prā kā ra hūm̐ paṃ hūm̐ rdo rje'i rwa ba/ oṃ badzra pañdza ra hūm̐ yaṃ hūm̐/ rdo rje'i gur/ oṃ badzra bi tā na hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐/ rdo rje'i bla re/ oṃ badzra shaḥr dzā la traṃ saṃ traṃ/ rdo rje'i mda'i dra ba/ oṃ badzra dzwa la a na lārkaka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phyi rol du rdo rje'i me'i rwa ba rab tu 'bar bas bskor bar gyur/ lha mo rnams kyi zhabs kyi 'og tu brub khung 'jigs su rung ba/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣṭān phaṭ/ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā pam̐ phaṭ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badzra dhā ra ādzñā pa ya sti sarba bighnān kā ya wākka tsitta badzra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces bka' bsgos pas lha mo rnams kyi bgegs rnams lcags kyus bkug zhags pas bcings te brub khung du dor ba'i spyi bor rdo rje phur bus btab/ oṃ badzra mutga ra badzra kī la ya ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ tho ba phur pa'i mgo bor bsnun pas bgegs rnams gdug pa'i sems dang bral nas zag pa med pa'i bde bas myos par gyur/ lha mo rnams 'od zer gyi rnam pas rwa gur la thim pas de sku gsum ye shes lnga'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/

lnga pa/ bdag nyid kyi spyi bor he/ mgrin par ru/ snying gar ka de las 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad la phog pas gzhi sku gsum bag chags sad/ lam rnam thar sgo gsum la gnas par byas te/ slar log ste yi ge gsum la thim/ he chos thams cad rgyu dang bral ba/ ru chos thams cad rtog pa med pa/ ka chos thams cad gang du yang mi gnas pa'o// de ltar ma shes pas sems can rnams 'khor bar ltung bar gyur na/ bdag dpal he ru kar gyur nas sems can thams cad kyis tshul 'di lta bur shes par bya'o/ snyam du chos thams cad la dmigs pa'i snying rje bskyed par bya'o/ /oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥ sarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ bdag dang yi ge gsum yongs su gyur pa'i 'og tu oṃ/ de'i steng du āḥde'i steng du hūm̐/ de gsum las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas de gsum la thim/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu ha/ de mgo bo/ de zla tshes/ de thig le/ de nā da la/ de las oṃ shūn+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko ྅haṃ/ rang sgra byung de'i rkyen gyis nā da de yang je phra je phrar gyur nas mthar dmigs pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur pa la cung zad mnyam par gzhag go drug pa/ de nas sngar gyi tshad med pa bzhi'i 'phen pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su/ e las chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du// yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ yongs su gyur pa las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po zla gam/ me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi brtsegs pa'i steng du/ suṃ ljang khu las ri rab kyi rtse mor/ paṃ las sna tshogs padmar/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte ba la/ bhūm̐ las rnam snang rig ma dang bcas pa 'od du zhu ba'i rin po che sna tshogs kyis khang pa brtsegs pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs la sogs pa mtshan nyid tshang ba dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba nang phyogs mdog can gyi dbus su bde chen gyi 'khor lo sdong bu dang bcas gyen du 'phags pa'i rin po che'i padma 'dab ma brgyad pa phyogs dmar mtshams ser nag ljang mthing kha/

mu khyud gri gug gi 'phreng ba can gyi lte bar nyi gdan la 'jigs byed nag po lag pa bzhi pa'i ro kha bub pa dang*/ dus mtshan ma gson mo gan rkyal bsgyel ba/ padma'i 'og gi nam mkhar mkha' spyod kyi yul brgyad kyi rang bzhin/ thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rdo rje'i mu khyud can/ sa gzhi'i thad du sa spyod kyi yul brgyad kyi rang bzhin gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po padma'i mu khyud can/ sa 'og tu sa 'og spyod kyi yul brgyad kyi rang bzhin sku'i 'khor lo dkar po 'khor lo'i mu khyud can/ thams cad rtsibs brgyad pa/ lha gnas thams cad du nyi ma dang ro gdan/ bdun pa/ lte ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ dbyangs tshar gnyis g.yon/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha kṣa ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha gsal byed gnyis g.yas su/ ā li dang kā li yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma dang zla ba kha sbyar gyi dbus su hūm̐ dngul chu lta bu dang a li khri lta bu las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs su bsgyur zhing tshur 'dus pas rdo rje hūm̐ dang gri gug as mtshan pa/ de thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma mnan pa/ g.yon cung zad bskum pas 'jigs byed sngon po'i dpral ba mnan pa/ rtsa zhal dkar po/ g.yon zhal ljang khu/ rgyab zhal dmar po/ g.yas zhal ser po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ nor bu dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ 'khor lo dang*/

rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ gdu bu dang*/ ska rags dang*/ thal chen te phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa ste/ sku dpa' ba dang*/ sgeg pa dang*/ 'jigs su rung ba dang*/ gsung rgod pa dang*/ gshe ba dang*/ rngam pa dang*/ thugs snying rje ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ ngo mtshar ba'o// phyag bcu gnyis kyis spras pa'i dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa/ gdengs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug /drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭwāṃ ga /bzhi pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ ant+ras gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'i phyag g.yon pas yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub steng gi nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi brla gnyis la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ yab yum gnyis ka'i spyi bor zla ba la oṃ/ mgrin pa dang snying gar nyi ma la āḥdang hūm̐/ sked pa'i mtshams su swa/ 'doms su āḥ brla zur la ha'o/ yab kyi gsang ba hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po/ baṃ las nor bu dmar po phaṭ ser pos bu ga bkag pa/ yum gyi mkha' āḥlas padma dmar po/ oṃ las ze'u 'bru dkar po phaṭ ser pos bu ga bkag pa/ yab yum snyom par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgra dang thugs kha'i 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gyi grub pa dang*/

sems can 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du sbyangs pa rnams spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar de dag snyom par zhugs pas bde ba chen por zhu ba zhal nas zhugs te a wa dhu tī brgyud rdo rje nor bu dang yum gyi ze'u 'bru 'dres par ltung bas yab yum bde ba'i gong bur zhu ba dngul chu'i rnam pa lta bu/ brgyad pa/ de la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ oṃ ma hā su khaṃ badzra satwa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥsu ra st+waṃ dṛ ṣya hoḥ zhes pa'i glus skul bas de nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa ind+ra nī la dang mtshungs pa'i sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma mnan pa/ g.yon cung brad bskum pas 'jigs byed sngon po'i dpral ba mnan pa/ rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yon zhal ljang gu/ rgyab zhal dmar po/ g.yas zhal ser po/ zhal re re la spyan/ gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ nor bu dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ 'khor lo dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgur rgyan dang*/ gdu bu dang*/ ska rags dang*/ thal chen te phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa ste/ sku dpa' ba dang*/ sgeg pa dang*/ 'jigs su rung ba dang*/ gsung rgod pa dang*/ gshe ba dang*/ rngam pa dang*/ thugs snying rje ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ ngo mtshar ba'o// phyag bcu gnyis kyis spras pa'i dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa/ gdengs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa ni gri gug /drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭwāṃ ga

/bzhi pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ ant+ras gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'i phyag g.yon pas yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub steng gi nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi brla gnyis la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ yab yum gnyis ka'i spyi bor zla ba la oṃ/ mgrin pa dang snying gar nyi ma la āḥdang hūm̐/ sked pa'i mtshams su swa/ 'doms su āḥ brla zur la ha'o/ gnas lnga mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab pa ni/ yab kyi gsang ba hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po/ baṃ las nor bu dmar po phaṭ ser pos bu ga bkag pa/ yum gyi mkha' āḥlas padma dmar po/ oṃ las ze'u 'bru sngon po phaṭ ser pos bu ga bkag pa/ yab yum snyom par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgra dang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis zhes pa'i bar sngar bzhin no// de nas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bkug /smin mtshams nas zhugs te thugs kar phyin pa dang rjes chags kyis zhu/ a wa dhū tī brgyud rdo rje nor bu nas yum gyi bha gar lhung ba 'khor lo sdom pa drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi rten dkyil 'khor brten pa lha'i rol mo mig 'bras su snang ba'i gzugs lta bur gyur pa las rten gzhal yas khang 'thon te phyi'i gzhal yas khang la thim/ de nas gtso bo yab yum 'thon nas bdag nyid la thim zhing*/ de nas rim pa bzhin 'thon pas/ shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/

mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la byang chub sems kyis gang ba'i bum pa bzhi'i steng du bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhi'o/ lha mo de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma g.yas gnyis gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas pad nyi dang ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ thod pa dang rdo rje 'phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can sku drag mo'i gzugs can du gyur/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi phyogs g.yon skor du/ dpa' bo thod pa'i dum bu dang dpa' mo rab gtum ma/ keng rus chen po dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ keng rus dang 'od ldan ma/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ me nas g.yas bskor gyis lha dgra dang dpa' bo'i blo gros ma/ 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ rdo rje'i lus dang shing grib ma rnams sngon po/ rim pa de nyid kyis gsung gi 'khor lo'i phyogs la/ myu gu can dang sa srung ma/ rdo rje'i ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ mtshams su rab tu bzang po dang sngo bsangs mo/ rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ 'jigs byed dang rta rna ma/ mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma thams cad dmar po/ sku'i 'khor lo'i phyogs la stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ rin chen rdo rje dang dum skyes ma/ rta mgrin dang chang 'tshong ma/ nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ mtshams la he ru ka dang bzhin bzang ma/ padma gar dbang dang stobs chen ma/ rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor lo sgyur ma/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo thams cad dkar po/ dpa' bo thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa thugs kyi g.yas rdo rje dang*/ gsung gi padma dang sku'i 'khor lo/

g.yon de so sos yu ba byas pa'i dril bu bzung ste dpa' mo la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma gnyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa spyan gsum pa ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ mi mgo skam po'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa'i do shal can/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan te skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa'i pang na dpa' mo rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin cing skra grol ba/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa'o// shar sgor khwa gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang gu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje bstan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba mo g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ lha mo de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma g.yas gnyis gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas pad nyi dang ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ thod pa dang rdo rje 'phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can sku drag mo'i gzugs can du gyur/ gtso bo dang lha mo rnams byang chub kyi phyogs so bdun/ so sen la sogs pa'i khams rnams dpa' bo nyer bzhir rnam par dag pa'o// dgu pa/ snying gar chu skyes 'dab ma brgyad kyi lte bar rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' sor bzhi tsam/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la snying po'i rnal 'byor ma dang mtshams la mchod pa bzhi'i gzugs/ gnas nyer bzhir lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag reg cing*/ puṃ dzāṃ oṃ aṃ goṃ raṃ deṃ māṃ kāṃ oṃ traṃ koṃ kāṃ laṃ kāṃ hiṃ preṃ greṃ sauṃ suṃ naṃ siṃ maṃ kuṃ/ yi ge de dag 'od du zhu ba las 'od kyi gur khang 'tshog ma pu li ra ma/ spyi gtsug dzā landha ra/

rna ba g.yas o rgyan/ ltag pa arbu ta/ bzhi gnas te sa rab tu dga' ba/ rna ba g.yon go dā wa ri dang*/ smin mtshams ra me shwa rī/ mig de wi ko ṭa/ phrag pa gnyis mā la wa bzhi nye ba'i gnas te sa dri ma med par rim pa ji lta ba'i thugs 'khor gyi dpa' bo dpa' mo brgyad/ mchan khung kā ma rū pa/ nu ma gnyis o ṭe/ gnyis zhing sa 'od byed pa/ lte ba tri sha ku ne/ sna rtse ko sa la gnyis nye zhing sa 'od 'phro ba/ kha ka liṅka mgrin pa lampā ka gnyis tshando/ sa sbyang ka ba/ snying kāñtsi ka /'doms hi ma la ya/ gnyis nye ba'i tshando/ sa mngon du gyur par rim pa ji lta ba'i gsung 'khor gyi dpa' bo dpa' mo brgyad/ mtshan ma pre ta pu ri/ bshang lam gṛ ha de wa gnyis 'du ba/ sa ring du song ba/ brla gnyis swo raṣṭa dang*/ byin pa gnyis su warṇa dwī ba gnyis nye ba'i 'du ba/ sa mi g.yo ba/ sor mo phal pa rnams na ga ra/ bol gong gnyis sindhu/ gnyis dur khrod/ sa legs pa'i blo gros/ mthe bong ma ru/ pus mo gnyis ku lu ta gnyis nye ba'i dur khrod/ sa chos kyi sprin/ rim pa ji lta ba'i sku 'khor gyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo brgyad/ kha sna sgo rtags bshang lam/ rna ba g.yon/ mig gnyis/ rna ba g.yas kyi bu gar sgo mtshams ma brgyad/ 'khor thams cad mtshon gang ba/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya wākka tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ oṃ badzra shuddhaḥ sarba dharmāḥ badzra shuddho3haṃ/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs mi 'gyur ba'i nga rgyal gzung ngo*// bcu pa/ oṃ haḥ gtso bo'i snying gar rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po dkar ser dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum rdo rje ḍā ma ru tshangs mgo g.yon gsum dril bu thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa/ na ma hi/ dpral bar rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ swa ha hu/ spyi bor rin chen 'byung gnas dmar po/ bau ṣa ṭa he/ phrag pa gnyis la he ru ka nag po/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥ spyan gsum la 'od dpag med mthing kha/ phaṭ haṃ yan lag thams cad la don yod grub pa ljang gu/ de thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis 'khor lo/ rin po che/ rdo rje/ padma/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang de'i dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba/ lhag ma gnyis ḍā ma ru dang thod pa/ dpa' bo'i chas kyis brgyan te g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ oṃ haḥn ma hi swa ha hu/ bau ṣa ṭa he/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥ phaṭ haṃ/ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ oṃ baṃ/ yum gyi lte bar phag mo dmar mo dmar ljang ser ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum gri gug kha ṭwāṃ ga lcags kyu/ g.yon gsum thod pa/ tshangs mgo zhags pa bsnams pa/ haṃ yoṃ snying gar gshin rje ma sngon mo/ hriṃ moṃ mgrin par rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ hreṃ hreṃ 'tshogs mar skyod byed ma ser mo/ hūm̐ hūm̐ spyi gtsug tu skrag byed ma ljang khu/ phaṭ phaṭ yan lag thams cad la tsaṇḍī ka dud kha/ de thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod pa/ lhag ma gnyis kha ṭwāṃ ga dang ḍā ma ru dpa' mo'i chas kyis brgyan te g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yauṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hreṃ hreṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐// phaṭ phaṭ kyi byin gyis brlab bo/ bcu gcig pa/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya mig g.yon gyi steng du bskor lta stangs der gtad rkang pa g.yas pas g.yon pa'i bol mnan/ snying kha'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus bsgoms pa ji lta ba'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo dbang lha rigs lnga dang bcas pa pheṃ/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ bcu gnyis pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ de dag gis spros pa'i gzugs ma rnams kyis bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pas ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin dag pa'i sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐ zhes pas dbang skur bas/ chu de las byung ba'i rigs kyi bdag po gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam snang*/ bde chen gyi lha mor rin 'byung*/ thugs la mi bskyod pa/ gsung la snang mtha'/ sku la snang mdzad/ dam tshig la don grub/ sprul sku'i cha lugs can gyis dbu brgyan par bya'o// bcu gsum pa/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ/ thugs kar hūm̐ las 'od zer spros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs bskul bas sems can gyi dug gsum sbyong bar mdzad de 'od zer dang lhan cig yi ge gsum la zhugs pas sku rdo rje gsung rdo rje thugs rdo rje rig ma dang bcas par gyur pa'i 'od kyis lus thams cad khyab par gyur/ bcu bzhi pa/ snying ga nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis/ rab mdzes blta bas mi ngom lang tsho can/ dga' ba'i nyams bzhis sgeg cing 'gying ba'i gzugs/ pi wang gling bu rnga zlum rdza rnga mas/ rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bas mchod par bgyi/ oṃ āḥbadzra wī ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ waṃ she= mu rañdze= mṛ taṃ ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ rab mdzes blta bas mi ngom lang tsho can/ mchog dga'i nyams bzhis sgeg cig 'gying ba'i gzugs// bzhed dang dregs ldan gru dbyangs gar mkhan mas/ rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bas mchod par bgyi/ oṃ āḥbadzra hā sya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ lā sya= gī tī= nṛ tya= rab mdzes blta bas mi ngom lang tsho can/ khyad dga'i nyams bzhis sgeg cing 'gying ba'i gzugs/

me tog bdug spos snang gsal dri chab mas/ rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bas mchod par bgyi/ oṃ āḥbadzra puṣpe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ dhū pe= di paṃ= gandhe= rab mdzes blta bas mi ngom lang tsho can/ lhan skyes dga' bzhis sgeg cing 'gying ba'i gzugs/ gzugs bcud reg bya chos dbyings rdo rje mas/ rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bas mchod par bgyi/ oṃ āḥbadzra rū pa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ra sya= sparshe= dharma dhā tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes rig ma bcu drug dang*/ mdun du rlung dang me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mgo bo gsum la gnas pa'i yi ge a rnam par gyur pa las thod pa'i nang du go ku na ha da las sha lnga/ bi mu shu ma ra las bdud rtsi lnga/ rang rang gi sa bon de dag gis mtshan pa'i khar oṃ/ de thams cad kyi ma dag pa sbyang*/ āḥlas byung ba'i zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje kha ṭwām̐ ga dkar po thur du lta bas kha bcad/ rlung gis me sbar rdzas rnams ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i rgyun nyi ma 'char kha lta bu la rdo rje kha ṭwām̐ ga dang bcas pa'i zla ba la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i dbang phyug rnams spyan drangs/ snyoms par zhugs nas thim pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsir zhu nas babs pas mi zad pa'i rgya mtsho kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs par gyur/ bdud rtsi gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te/ spyan ma mā kī gos dkar sgrol ma rnams// rang rang sku yi mchod pa yang dag lhan// rus pa'i rgyan ldan thod pa bdud rtsis gang*// rjod pa med pa 'dren pa 'khor bcas mchod// yab yum gnyis ka'i spyi bor zla ba la oṃ/ mgrin pa dang snying khar nyi ma la āḥdang hūm̐/ rked pa'i mtshams su swa/ 'doms su a/ brla zur la ha'o/ yab kyi gsang bar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po/ baṃ las nor bu dmar po phaṭ ser pos bu ga bkag pa/ yum gyi mkha' a las padma dmar po/ oṃ las ze'u 'bru sngon po phaṭ ser pos bu ga bkag pa/

rang gi lte snying du zla ba la/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇaṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ yum gyi snying po nye snying*/ lkog ma dang spyi bor nyi ma la/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki ni dzā la samba raṃ swāhā/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ yab kyi snying po nye snying*/ yum gyi lte snying du nyi ma la/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki ni dzā la samba raṃ swāhā/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ yab kyi snying po nye snying*/ lkog ma dang spyi bor zla ba la/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇaṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ yum gyi snying po nye snying bsam/ sngags de dag kha dog dmar po 'od zer du ma 'khrigs pa/ yab kyi gsang ba nas yum gyi mkhar brgyud de zhal nas zhal du 'khor bar dmigs la rjes su chags pas mchod par byas la/ mthar lhan skyes kyi ye shes ngos bzung*/ nas de la mnyam par gzhag par bya ste de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o/ de nas phyi nang gi lha mo rnams kyis/ yab yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bī re shā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā kalpāgni sanni bhā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dza ṭā ma ku ṭotka ṭa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dam̐ṣṭ+rā ka rā lo gra bhī ṣa ṇa mu khā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pa ra shu pā sho dya ta shū la kha ṭwāṃ ga dhā ri ṇe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ byā ghrā dzi nāmbha ra dha rā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā dhū mrāndha kā ra wa pu ṣā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badzra bā rā hi baṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ārya pa rā dzi te trai lokyā mā te ma hā bidye shwa ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ sarba bhū ta bha ya ba he ma hā badzre hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badzra pa ni a dzi ti a pa rā dzi te ba shyaṃ ka ri ne tra bhra ma ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sho ṣa ṇa ro ṣa kro dha de ka rā le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ tra pa ni mā ra ṇa su pra bhe da ni pa rā dza ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dza ye bi dza ye dzambha n-i stambha ni mo ha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badzra bā rā hi ma hā yo gi ni kā me shwa ri kha ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ rkang pa brgyad pas bstod pa thun mong pa dang*/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki ni dzā la samba raṃ swāhā/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇaṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ lā ma ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ru pi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ka ra ka ra khaṇḍa ka pā la/ pra tsaṇḍe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ku ru ku ru ma hā kaṃ kā la/ tsaṇḍā kṣe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bandha bandha kaṃ kā la/ pra bhā wa tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ trā sa ya trā sa ya bi ga ṭa daṃṣṭa ṇa/ ma hā na sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kṣo bha ya kṣo bha ya sū ra wai tī/ bī ri ma tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hrauṃ hrauṃ a mṛ ta bha ba/ kha ba rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hraḥhraḥbadzra pra bha wa/ laṅke shwa rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pheṃ pheṃ badzra de ha dru matstsha ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ phaṭ phaṭ aṅku rī ka e rā pa tā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ da ha da ha badzra dza ṭi la ma hā bhai ra wi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa ma hā wī ra wā yu be ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bhakṣa bhakṣa ba sa ru dhi rānt+ra mā lā wa lambi ni badzra hūm̐ ka ra/ su ra bhakṣi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa sapta pā tā la ga ta bhu dzaṅgaṃ sarbaṃ bā tardza ya tardza ya su bha dra/

shyā ma de wi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā kaḍḍha ā kaḍḍha badzra pra bha su bha dre huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ ma hā bhai ra ba/ ha ya karṇe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dznauṃ dznauṃ bi rū pākṣa/ kha gā na ne huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ kṣ+māṃ kṣ+māṃ ma hā ba la/ tsakra be ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ haṃ haṃ ratna badzra khaṇḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hīṃ hīṃ ha ya gṛ ba/ shoṇḍi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ ā kā sha garbha tsakra warmi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ki li ki li he ru ka /su bī rī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ si li si li padma nirti shwa ra/ mahā ba le huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hi li hi li bai ro tsa na/ tsakra warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dhi li dhi li badzra sa twa/ mahā bīrya ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ka kā sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ u lū kā sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shwa nā ka sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ su ka rā sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma da dhī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma dū tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma daṃṣṭi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma ma thā nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ so so'i sngags kyis bstod pa thun mong min pa'o// bco lnga pa/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar zla ba la hūm̐ yig ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' de'i thig le sangs rgyas lnga'i rang bzhin gyi 'od zer 'ja' khyim lta bu'i dbus su rten brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom zhing gsal ba dang rlung phyir 'phro dus 'od zer sna la 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs bzhugs pa spros pas snod gzhal yas khang bcud kyi sems can thams cad nyid dang mtshungs pa'i dkyil 'khor du sbyangs pa/ slar der bsdus pa sngar bzhin du yang yang bsgom/ de brtan pa dang yab yum gyi gsang ba'i rtse phrad pa'i dbus su ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' de la sngar bzhin/ de la goms nas kun rdzob kyi sna rtser ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' bkod pa la bya ste/

oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa sapta pā tā la ga ta bhu dzaṅgaṃ sarbaṃ bā tardza ya tardza ya su bha dra/ shyā ma de wi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā kaḍḍha ā kaḍḍha badzra pra bha su bha dri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ ma hā bhai ra ba/ ha ya karṇe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dznauṃ dznauṃ bi rū pākṣa/ kha gā na ne huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ kṣ+māṃ kṣ+māṃ ma hā ba la/ tsakra be ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ haṃ haṃ ratna badzra khaṇḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hīṃ hīṃ ha ya gṛ ba/ shoṇḍi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ ā kā sha garbha tsakra warmi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ki li ki li he ru ka /su bī rī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ si li si li padma nirti shwa ra/ mahā ba le huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hi li hi li bai ro tsa na/ tsakra warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dhi li dhi li badzra sa twa/ mahā bīrya ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ka kā sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ u lū kā sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shwa nā sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ su ka rā sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma da dhī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma dū tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma daṃṣṭi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma ma thā nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ haḥ na ma hi/ swa ha hu/ bau ṣṭa he/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥ phaṭ haṃ/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yoṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ/

de ltar dmigs pa dang brjod pa'i bzlas pa gnyis bskyed pa'i rim pa nas bsgom par bya ba yin la/ lhag ma gnyis ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i bsgom byar bshad do/ bcu drug pa/ sna g.yas pa'i ā li dang kā li 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa'i rtser 'khor lo gsum gyi lha bzhugs pa spros/ sa gsum po sbyangs nas de gsum gyi rang bzhin du byas te gdod nas grub pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams dang mnyam du sna g.yon pa'i bu ga nas zhugs te lte ba'i thad du phyin pas ā li kā li las zla ba dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams las hūm̐ dkar la dmar ba bltas te/ slar de bcom ldan 'das phyag gnyis pa yab yum rjes su chags pa'i rol mo mdzad pa lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba nyams su myong ba'i sgras/ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor rnams bskul bas bde ba chen pos tshim ste dur khrod nas rim gyis lte ba'i yab yum la bsdu/ de gnyis kyang zhu nas zla ba hūm̐ dang bcas pa der gyur cing*/ de yang zla ba hūm̐ la thim/ de nā da'i bar du sngar bzhin bsdus nas/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu ha/ de mgo bo/ de zla tshes de thig le/ de nā da la thim/ nā da la cung zad sems bcing ngo*/ des nā da de yang je phra je phrar yal nas dmigs pa thams cad dang bral ba'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa la 'jug par bya'o// de las skyo ba dang nā da dang hūm̐ de las skad cig gis dkyil 'khor du ldang bar bya'o/ ༈ mdun bskyed dang 'brel tshe 'di nas bzhug rdul tshon la nyin gnyis pa nas/ oṃ badzra uttiṣṭha dkyil 'khor chen po skad cig gis nam mkha' la 'phags par gyur/ ras bris dang 'brel ba'i skabs gtan nas mi dgos/ bcu bdun pa/ gtor ma bshams bsang gtor byas/ mdun du rlung dang me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mgo bo gsum la gnas pa'i yig ge a rnam par 'gyur ba las thod pa'i nang du go ku na ha da las sha lnga/

bi mu shu ma ra las bdud rtsi lnga/ rang rang gi sa bon de dag gis mtshan pa'i khar oṃ/ de thams cad kyis ma dag pa sbyangs/ āḥlas byung ba'i zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ga dkar po thur du blta bas kha bcad rlung gis me sbar rdzas rnams ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i rgyun nyi ma 'char ka lta bu la rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ga dang bcas pa'i zla ba la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i dbang phyug rnams spyan drangs snyom par zhugs nas thim ye shes kyi bdud rtsir zhu nas babs pas mi zad pa'i rgya mtsho kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs par gyur/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang lta stangs rkang pa g.yas kyis g.yon mnan/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ gu ru shri badzra yo gi nī ā kaḍḍha ya ā kaḍḍha ya/ pra be sha ya pra be sha ya/ bandha ya bandha ya/ to ṣa ya to ṣa ya sarba badzra ḍā ki nī hṛ da ya/ a pa to ṣa ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sarba bī ra yo gi nī swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i gzugs kyis dkyil 'khor chen po'i 'jig rten pa thams cad kyis bshul 'brang ba dang bcas nam mkha' dang sa gzhi bar snang thams cad gang bar byon/ lag pa pad kor byas te/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ lan gsum/ mchod bya dang mchod byed gnyis med du byas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ lag pa g.yon zla ba/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣa/ lag pa g.yas nyi ma/ kha sbyor gyi bar du hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga taḥ sarba dharmaḥ pa ra spa ra a nu pra b-iṣṭaḥsarba dharma/ a tyanta a nu pra biṣṭha sarba dharma oṃ āḥhūm̐/ nyi zla hūm̐ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pas rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i dbus su gtor ma bzhag ste/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*/ des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te/

bden pa des kyang lha mo de dag rnams/ bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig oṃ ā ra li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbadzra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya st+waṃ dṛ tya hoḥ lnga'am bdun gyis bcom ldan 'das rig mar bcas pa dang*/ oṃ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ bandha bandha/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ kṣo bha ya kṣo bha ya/ hrauṃ hrauṃ/ hraḥhraḥ/ pheṃ pheṃ/ phaṭ phaṭ/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhakṣa bhakṣa ba sa ru dhi rānt+ra mā lā wa lambi ni/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa sapta pā tā la ga ta bhu dzaṅgaṃ sarb+baṃ bā tardza ya tardza ya/ oṃ ā kaḍḍha ā kaḍḍha/ hrīṃ hrīṃ*/ dznauṃ dznauṃ/ kṣ+māṃ kṣ+māṃ/ hāṃ hāṃ/ hīṃ hīṃ/ hū'um̐ hūm̐/ ki li ki li/ si li si li/ hi li hi li/ dhi li dhi li/ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes 'khor lo gsum gyi lha/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yakṣa/ rākṣa sa bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsonma dā pa smā ra/ badzra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā dā ya/ i maṃ ba liṃ gṛ hṇantu/ sa ma ya rakṣantu/ ma ma sarba siddhi mme pra yatstshantu/ ya thai baṃ/ ya the ṣṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha khā da tha/ pi wa tha/ dzi ghra tha/ mā ti pra ma tha/ ma ma sarba ka ra ta ya/ sata su khaṃ bi bṛ dha ye sata ha yi kā bha wantu hūm̐ ham̐'u phaṭ/ dur khrod kyi phyogs skyong zhing skyong thams cad la phul/ oṃ āḥbadzra wī ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā badzra waṃ she hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ mu rañdze= mṛ taṃ gi= hā sya= lā sya= gī ti= nṛ tya= puṣpe= dhū pe= ā lo ke= gandhe= rū pa= rā sya= sparshe= dharma dhā tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ gang drin shwa lo ka dang*/ bcom ldan mgon po dpa' bo'i dbang phyug ni// bskal pa'i me chen ltar bur rab tu 'bar// ral pa'i cod pan dbu yi rgyan du bcings// mche ba rab brtsegs drag shul rngam pa'i zhal// sku la phyag stong gzi brjid ldan pa po// dgra st+wa zhags pa kha ṭwām̐ mdung bsnams shing*// rab 'jigs stag gi pags pa gos su gyon// sku chen dud kha bgegs mthar mdzad la 'dud// bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo 'phags ma ni// 'jig rten gsum sogs phyogs gzhan rgol bas mi thub cing*// 'byung po'i 'jig pa ma lus rdo rje chen mos 'joms// rdo rje gdan bzhugs tshangs sogs dbang bsgyur las rgyal zhing*// rdo rje phag mo khro mo'i gzugs can drag snyems ma// rmug byed rengs byed myos byed las ni rnam rgyal zhing*// bdud kyi 'jigs pa pham zhing skem par 'dzad pa mo// rnal 'byor chen mo 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod//

zhes rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam pas chags pa bcom zhing yang dag rtog pa bcom// khyod ni dngos po thams cad mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bdag nyid gzigs par ldan// mgon po thugs rje'i chu yi brjid kyis brlan par gyur pa'i thugs kyi chus// bdag la mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyis shin tu rjes brtser mdzad du gsol// zhes dkyil 'khor la 'dod gsol byas/ 'jig rten pa rnams la/ dam can rgya mtsho khyed rnams kyis// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yis// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba// bde legs thams cad 'grub pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /de bzhin pha rol tshogs 'joms shing*// dgra rnams thams cad pham par mdzod// ces pa'i 'phrin las bcol/ oṃ shrī hai ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya shri he ru ka twe no pa tiṣṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su poṣyo me bha wa/ sarba siddhi mme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsittaṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badzra mā me muñtsa/ he ru ka bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ zhes lhag chad bskang*/ nyer bsdu'i phyag rgya'i mthar se gol brdab cing*/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// ji ltar bde bar bzhugs su gsol// oṃ badzra muḥ

gtor mgron gshegs su gsol/ bdag bskyed rkyang pa'i skabs/ 'dir rdo rje'i tshig rkang gsung*/ de nas thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dkyil 'khor thams cad snang bar byas te thams cad 'od kyi rang bzhin du bdag la thim/ de yum bcas ye shes sems dpa'/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ/ padma'i lag kor gyis mnyes par byas te/ de hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ thun mtshams kyi he ru ka phyag gnyis par bzhengs/ gzugs kyi phung po rnam par snang mdzad/ tshor ba rdo rje nyi ma/ 'du shes padma gar dbang*/ 'du byed rdo rje rgyal po/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po mi bskyod pa/ ye shes kyi phung po dpal he ru ka sa khams ltung byed ma/ chu gsod byed ma/ me 'gugs byed ma/ rlung gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ nam mkha' padma dra ba can ma/ ye shes kyi khams chos kyi dbyings kyis dbang phyug ma/ mig gti mug rdo rje/ rna ba zhe sdang rdo rje/ sna ser sna rdo rje/ lce 'dod chags rdo rje/ lus phrag dog rdo rje/ yid dbang phyug rdo rje/ zhes phung khams rnam par dag pa dpa' bo dang*/ phyag rgya sngags dang kha ṭwāṃ ga'i dag pa byas/ go cha chen pos bsrungs te/ snang grags dran rtog thams cad he ru ka'i sku gsung thugs kyi rol par brtag pa la nan tan bya'o/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo'o/ shis pa brjod/ de ltar snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i bskyed pa'i rim pa rgyas pa ste/ nā ro pa chen po'i gzhung dpang por bzhag pa 'di yang*/ padma dkar pos byar yul gyi sa'i thig ler bkod pa'o/ zhar byung mchan bu/ kun mkhyen chen po/ mkha' 'gro dga' ba rgyud sde'i sde'i snying po'i nang du/ 'di'i sngags byang skor bshad mdzad pa'i nang*/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i sngags rnams/ hum̐ dang po thung ngu dang*/ phyi ma ring po ste/ de'i mthar phaṭ yig go ces gsungs/ huṃ thung sku gsum dang*/ hūm̐ ring sku snga 'tshon pas zla tshes yod med de de'i yin zhes rgyal ba mdo khams brgyad pas gsungs/// /
